<subagent sessionID="ses_e46d71842ffeu75Xu2qrRqE6kx" state="completed">
## Repository findings

This repository currently has **no app or game source code**: there are no HTML, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, or package-manifest files, and no existing frontend framework can be identified. The tracked project files are only the README and an OpenCode GitHub workflow; the launcher/helper files are present in the workspace but are untracked.

### Existing files of note

- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md) — project/OMGithub links; no app instructions.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh) — delegates startup to `node "${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs"`; the runtime script is external to this repository.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh) — delegates capture to the external runtime.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/startup.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/startup.sh) — contains only the Bash shebang and strict-mode setting.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md) — operational notes, including mobile-game guidance.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.github/workflows/opencode.yml`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.github/workflows/opencode.yml) — automation workflow, not part of the game.

## Files needed for the game

There are no existing game files to edit. Implementing the playable slow-progression tool-upgrade game will require scaffolding the app. A minimal frontend could add:

- `package.json` — dependencies and development/build scripts, if using a Node-based frontend.
- `index.html` — document entry point.
- `src/main.js` (or `src/main.ts`) — game state, progression, tool upgrades, input, and rendering.
- `src/style.css` — layout and responsive presentation.

Those are suggested new files, not paths already present in the repository. No existing app scripts are available; `start.sh` relies on the external `RUNTIME_DIR` setup.
</subagent>

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
